How we ensure accuracy in our content

What is Eucryl Tooth Powder?

Why are my teeth discoloured?

How will this powder remove stains from my teeth?

How to use Eucryl Tooth Powder

What is Eucryl Tooth Powder?

Eucryl Tooth Powder is a stain removal powder which helps to clean your teeth, letting their natural whiteness shine through. The Freshmint flavour of this cleaning powder is the perfect remedy for stained teeth, leaving your teeth clean and breath smelling fresh.

 

Why are my teeth discoloured?

There are lots of different things that can stain your teeth, leaving them looking less than their best. Some of the most common causes of stained teeth include:

  • Smoking or tobacco
  • Red wine
  • Coffee and tea
  • Other foods and drinks with strong colours

 

How will this powder remove stains from my teeth?

Eucryl Tooth Powder uses its unique powder formula to remove stains from your teeth gently and effectively. The naturally abrasive powder is the perfect way to remove stains caused by smoking, food, or drink, cleaning them away and leaving your teeth looking bright and fresh.

 

How to use Eucryl Tooth Powder

Before using this product, wet your toothbrush and shake off excess water. Press your toothbrush into the Eucryl Tooth Powder and brush your teeth. For best results, use once or twice a week in addition to usual toothpaste, and brush as your dentist recommends.

 

When should Eucryl Tooth Powder not be used?

Eucryl Tooth Powder is not suitable for children. Do not use this product if you’re allergic to any of the listed ingredients. If you experience any irritation while using this product, stop using right away. Avoid use on damaged teeth.

 

Important Information

This product is a medicine; make sure to speak to your doctor or Chemist 4 U pharmacist before taking this product if you have an underlying medical problem or are taking any other medicine or complementary therapy. If your symptoms get worse or continue after taking this product, contact us or your doctor. For medical services in your area, please refer to https://www.nhs.uk

If you are pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, speak to your doctor or our pharmacist before taking this product. If you suffer from any allergies, ask your doctor or our pharmacist if this medicine is right for you.

Store all medicines out of sight and reach of children.

Please read the included leaflet carefully before using this product.

Please contact your GP if appropriate regarding this product.
